tutorial.title: Growing Flex Items
tutorial.descriptionContent: Learn how to make flex items grow to fit their containers.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Let's learn how to use the properties of flex items to make them grow inside their container.

To see how the first HUD slot can grow to the size of its container, use the buttons to toggle the use of the property flex-grow.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
To control how a HUD slot grows across its main axis, we use flex-grow inside a flex item rule.

Make sure to pick flex-grow.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
The default value for flex-grow is 0. That means that the HUD slot doesn't adapt in size at all and is only as wide as its content. Code 0.

Make sure to type 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
To make an item grow, we set flex-grow to 1.

Make sure to type 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
Here, the first HUD slot has flex-grow: 1;, while the second defaults to 0. The one with the bigger number gets the most space.

Make sure to pick 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
Items with bigger flex-grow values get more of the empty space left inside the container. A smaller container means they get less space.

Make sure to pick width followed by : and then 60%, ;.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent: Use the buttons to change the flex-direction and flex-grow properties to see how it affects the first HUD slot.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does the flex-grow property do?

It controls how a flex item grows across the main axisIt controls how a flex item grows in height and width

It controls how a flex item grows across the main axis.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
What is the default flex-grow value?

0auto

Make sure to pick 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which value makes a flex item grow?

1100%

Make sure to pick 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which flex items can have a flex-grow property.

Any and all flex itemsOnly one flex item

Any and all flex items.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set flex-grow to 1?

The flex item can grow as much as there's empty space in the containerThe flex item doubles in size

The flex item can grow as much as there's empty space in the container.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the flex-grow property.

Make sure to type flex-grow.

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the default flex-grow value, 0.

Make sure to type 0.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make the flex item of class .hp grow, by coding the value 1.

Make sure to pick 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the values so that only the flex item of class .score grows.

Make sure to pick 0, followed by 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #17
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make both flex items grow equally and set a container size of 200px.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 1, and finally 200px.

lessons.title: Lesson #1
lessons.interactiveContent:
Let's learn to use flex-grow on multiple HUD slots.

Press the different buttons to see how flex-grow changes how much the first HUD slot can grow compared to the other slots.

lessons.title: Lesson #2
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can set flex-grow for all HUD slots inside a flex container. If we set all of them to 1, they grow equal in size and fill out the HUD bar.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 1, and finally 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #3
lessons.interactiveContent:
The values we set for flex-grow are ratios. If we set flex-grow to the same number for all HUD slots, they'll stay equal in size.

Make sure to pick 100, followed by 100, and finally 100.

lessons.title: Lesson #4
lessons.interactiveContent:
If we want to make the Health slot bigger, we give it a bigger flex-grow value than the other two slots.

Make sure to pick 2, followed by 1, and finally 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #5
lessons.interactiveContent:
The higher the number, the bigger the ratio of a HUD bar's empty space we give a slot.

Make sure to pick 20.

lessons.title: Lesson #6
lessons.interactiveContent:
We can set different ratios to provide different sizes for each HUD slot. To make each slot bigger than the previous one, add 1, 2, and 3.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 2, and finally 3.

lessons.title: Lesson #7
lessons.interactiveContent: Try out different flex directions and flex-grow values to see more of how it works.

lessons.title: Lesson #8
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set all HUD slots inside a container to flex-grow: 1;.

They all grow equal in size and fill the containerThey all grow to the flex-basis value

They all grow equal in size and fill the container.

lessons.title: Lesson #9
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set all HUD slots inside a container to flex-grow: 100;.

They all grow equal in size and fill the containerThey overflow the container

They all grow equal in size and fill the container.

lessons.title: Lesson #10
lessons.interactiveContent:
How do we make a HUD slot grow more than another?

By giving it a bigger flex-grow valueBy giving it a smaller flex-grow value

By giving it a bigger flex-grow value.

lessons.title: Lesson #11
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we set a bigger flex-grow value?

We give the flex item a bigger ratio of a container's empty spaceThe flex item has a bigger size in percentages

We give the flex item a bigger ratio of a container's empty space.

lessons.title: Lesson #12
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which HUD slots have the same flex-grow value?

Slots Health and ScoreSlots Health, Score, and Ammo

Slots Health and Score.

lessons.title: Lesson #13
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make all HUD slots grow the same amount.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 1, and finally 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #14
lessons.interactiveContent:
Make all HUD slots grow the same amount.

Make sure to pick 5, followed by 5, and finally 5.

lessons.title: Lesson #15
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the values so that the second HUD slot is bigger and the other two slots are equal.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 3, and finally 1.

lessons.title: Lesson #16
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the values so that the first and second slots are the same size and the third slot is the biggest size it can be.

Make sure to pick 1, followed by 1, and finally 10.

lessons.title: Lesson #17
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the values so that the HUD slots start off big and get smaller at the end.

Make sure to pick 5, followed by 3, and finally 1.
